heroHeadline: Bad Bunny at the 2026 Met Gala — Fifth Year Running; "DtMF" Holds All-Time Hot Latin Songs Record at 57 Weeks; European Tour Opens May 22 Barcelona
heroSubtitle: Tracking the rise from SoundCloud uploads in Vega Baja to 100 billion Spotify streams, a historic Super Bowl LX halftime performance, and Grammy Album of the Year. Bad Bunny attends the 2026 Met Gala on May 4 — his fifth consecutive appearance — as "DtMF" holds the all-time record of 57 consecutive weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot Latin Songs chart (chart dated May 2, 2026), the longest run in the chart's 60+ year history, surpassing "Despacito." The European leg of the Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour opens May 22 in Barcelona (Estadi Olímpic, two sold-out nights), then Lisbon (May 26–27) and Madrid (10 sold-out nights). Spotify's 20th anniversary confirmed Bad Bunny #2 all-time most-streamed artist globally; Un Verano Sin Ti is the most-streamed album in Spotify history (22B+ streams).
footerNote: Data sourced from Rimas Entertainment, Billboard, Spotify Newsroom, RIAA, Latin Recording Academy, Recording Academy, Pollstar, Bloomberg, NPR, Remezcla, SoleRetriever, Deadline, Variety, CNN, Rolling Stone, and major media
